commitments.title: Cut community emissions 50% by 2030
commitments.target: Cut community greenhouse gas emissions by 50% below 2010 levels by 2030.

progress.text: The community target requires cutting emissions 50% below 2010 levels by 2030.

citations.quote: Our community GHG targets: 80% emissions reduction (below 2010 baseline levels) by the year 2050, With an interim target of a 50% reduction by 2030.

progress.text: In 2022, emissions were 12% below 2010 levels, leaving the region behind its 2030 goal.

citations.quote: In 2022 we saw a 12% emissions reduction (below 2010 levels). Although we are seeing some progress and sustained emissions reductions, we are not on track for our 50% emissions reduction target by 2030

unclear: Emissions figures after 2022 are not provided in the source documents.
commitments.relation: The budget sets transit and service spending that affects community carbon emissions.

commitments.title: Close the municipal infrastructure funding gap
commitments.target: Fully fund annual infrastructure renewal needs of $321.5 million.

progress.text: Optimal yearly upkeep needs were set at $321.5 million.

citations.quote: The annual average level of investment in asset renewal over the ten-year capital program of $233.9 million falls short of the optimal level of investment needs identified in the 2026 progress report of $321.5 million.

progress.text: Ten-year spending averages $233.9 million, leaving an $87.6 million yearly gap.

citations.quote: In 2026, the Region’s infrastructure funding gap has grown from $82.8M per year to $87.6M per year.

The annual average level of investment in asset renewal over the ten-year capital program of $233.9 million falls short of the optimal level of investment needs identified in the 2026 progress report of $321.5 million. This represents a renewal funding shortfall or infrastructure funding gap of $87.6 million per year.

unclear: The documents do not show how fast Council plans to close the shortfall.
